title: SALAD: Improving Robustness and Generalization through Contrastive Learning with Structure-Aware and LLM-Driven Augmented Data

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model accuracy and robustness on counterfactually augmented test sets and out-of-distribution datasets across sentiment analysis and natural language inference tasks to evaluate reliance on non-causal, shortcut features.

Evaluating model performance on a sexism classification task using a dataset of original sexist statements paired with human-annotated, counterfactually revised non-sexist counterparts to measure robustness.
